mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM likes l LEFT JOIN posts p ON l.type = 0 AND l.target_id = p.id LEFT JOIN share s ON l.type = 1 AND l.target_id = s.id WHERE l.create_time >= #{po.startDate} AND l.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{po.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND l.status = 0 AND ( (l.type = 0 AND p.author_id = #{po.userId} AND p.status = 2) OR (l.type = 1 AND s.author_id = #{po.userId} AND s.status = 2) ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM collect c left join posts p on c.post_id = p.id WHERE c.create_time >= #{po.startDate} AND c.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{po.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND c.status = 0 AND p.author_id = #{po.userId} AND p.status = 2 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM comments c LEFT JOIN posts p ON c.type = 0 AND c.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN share s ON c.type = 1 AND c.post_id = s.id WHERE c.create_time >= #{po.startDate} AND c.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{po.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND c.status = 0 AND ( (c.type = 0 AND p.author_id = #{po.userId} AND p.status = 2) OR (c.type = 1 AND s.author_id = #{po.userId} AND s.status = 2) ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date_seq.date AS date, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_focus WHERE focus_user_id = #{po.userId} AND DATE(create_time) <= date_seq.date ) AS count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(#{po.startDate}, INTERVAL seq.day DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS day UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35 UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49 UNION ALL SELECT 50 UNION ALL SELECT 51 UNION ALL SELECT 52 UNION ALL SELECT 53 UNION ALL SELECT 54 UNION ALL SELECT 55 UNION ALL SELECT 56 UNION ALL SELECT 57 UNION ALL SELECT 58 UNION ALL SELECT 59 UNION ALL SELECT 60 ) seq WHERE DATE_ADD(#{po.startDate}, INTERVAL seq.day DAY) <= #{po.endDate} ) date_seq ORDER BY date_seq.date ASC

SELECT p.id AS id, p.author_id as userId, p.title AS title, p.introduction AS introduction, p.image AS image, p.type AS type, p.post_type AS post_type, p.create_time AS create_time, p.update_time AS update_time, IFNULL(browse_count.browse_count, 0) AS browse_count, IFNULL(like_count.like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(collect_count.collect_count, 0) AS collect_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS browse_count FROM browse WHERE type = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) browse_count ON p.id = browse_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id AS post_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM likes WHERE type = 0 AND status = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) like_count ON p.id = like_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS collect_count FROM collect WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) collect_count ON p.id = collect_count.post_id WHERE p.author_id = #{userId} AND p.status = #{type} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
